title: Retail pharmacy company unifies data for clear and transparent employment analytics.
summary: A Fortune 50 healthcare company improved its recruitment efficiency by unifying data analytics on a single platform, reducing manual reporting and enhancing insights.
body_markdown:
**Company/Industry** A Fortune 50 healthcare company.


**Challenge** Multiple tracking systems, manual ad hoc reporting, no unified metric definitions, and frequent unannounced ATS changes that caused rework.


**Solution** Standardized metrics and workflows, with data from multiple ATS and CRM systems consolidated in one Sevayo platform and supported by ongoing training.


**Result** One platform for real-time reporting, a major reduction in manual reporting, and an expanded predictive analysis capability.


## **Challenge: disconnected data sources create reliability and efficiency issues for business leaders.**


Data reliability and transparency were essential to this Fortune 50 healthcare company with up to 12,000 annual hires


in 44 states, with our RPO team managing 3,000-4,000 of them. HR and recruitment teams used multiple systems to track and report data, and they wasted time building ad hoc reports and verifying accuracy manually. Senior leaders struggled with a lack of unified definitions and formatting. Frequent changes to the applicant tracking system (ATS), often without warning, caused rework of reporting.


## **Solution: standardized metrics and workflows, with data consolidated in one [Sevayo ®](https://www.kellyservices.com/divisions/outsourcing-consulting-group/expertise/workforce-technology/) platform.**


Our team built stronger data analytics and implemented the data intelligence and insights needed via our[Sevayo®](https://www.kellyservices.com/divisions/outsourcing-consulting-group/expertise/workforce-technology/) workforce technology platform to support more impactful strategic talent acquisition decisions.


We partnered with their HR team to define key performance indicator (KPI) measurements for RPO and in-house recruitment teams, and we standardized ATS user workflows for consistent system usage across recruitment teams. Sevayo aggregates data from multiple ATS and customer relationship management (CRM) systems to capture data and visualize analysis in one user platform. Training sessions with HR Shared Services and HR business partners supported adoption.


## **Result: a single platform for real-time reporting and predictive insight.**


The program resulted in:


-


- A drastic reduction of manual reporting


- A single platform to track, monitor, and report on TA progress across the enterprise


- Multi-user access to real-time analysis and reporting via online portal without manual intervention


- A predictive analysis capability for recruitment sub-cycles and workflows, used to drive recruiter performance and set goals


- The ability to report on source-of-hire and ROI analysis
